text: SUNFDeltaContract[exp] substitutes for all SUNFDelta in exp SUNFDeltaContract, contracts the fundamental \(\text{SU}(N)\) indices and resubstitutes SUNFDelta.SUNFDeltaContract[i, j] is the Kronecker-delta for \(\text{SU}(N)\) in the fundamental representation with contraction properties. It wraps the head SUNFIndex around its arguments.
